Flow

  1. Landing. The Home stage: the turning bridge in its band, the name, one line, and the figures as a survey legend, each with its status dot and word.

  2. Take the guided tour. The one ochre button. Enter Tower Bridge and Play the 60 s story sit beside it as text links.

  3. The scene. The bridge on its measured ground, full bleed; the opaque panel at the left, the dock along the bottom, the view controls at the top right. The guide card steps through the tour with an ochre Next.

  4. A part. Tap a part on the bridge or in the panel's list; the inspector shows its figures, each with a status chip and a source chip.

  5. The year. Drag the year slider in the dock; the ochre thumb is the live year mark and the ticks mark events and build stages.

  6. The docent. Ask at the foot of the panel; the answer comes with source chips, or a calm refusal chip when it cannot cite one.

Do and don’t

  • DoGive Survey Ochre to one control per stage and to the live year thumb, nothing else.

    Don’tUse ochre for a selected state, a toggle, a tick or decoration; selected is ink with paper text.

  • DoMake every panel, dock, card and modal opaque Survey Paper with one 1px Hairline.

    Don’tPut blur, glass, transparency or a shadow over the scene; the focus ring's paper halo is the only box-shadow.

  • DoShow a status as a dot plus its word: measured in green, text-attested in blue, inferred in grey with a dashed edge.

    Don’tShow a figure without its status and source, or a status dot without its word.

  • DoSet names in Geologica 600 and everything else in Public Sans 400 or 600, self-hosted from @fontsource.

    Don’tReach for weight 500 or a font CDN: only 400 and 600 ship, so 500 renders as 400.

  • DoUse 4px for controls, 8px for panels, and full round only for chips and round marks.

    Don’tRound a button or input into a pill; the short name --pill is the 4px control radius.

  • DoSet every changing number in tabular figures and read figures as a legend: figure, status, source.

    Don’tLay numbers out as a row of stat tiles or put a card over the bridge.

  • DoKeep the height ramp (deep blue to teal to ochre) where it encodes height on the point cloud.

    Don’tPut a gradient on a button, heading, background or divider.

  • DoWrite plain verbs and numbers with their source: "North tower, 65 m, text-attested."

    Don’tWrite superlatives or "Oops! Something went wrong."; say what cannot be done and what still works.

  • DoSet secondary text in muted on surface: 6.52:1.

    Don’tPut muted text on the accent: 1.84:1, under AA.
